create_DirWatcher: create a DirWatcher instance to monitor one or more directories for file modifications
build_DirWatcher_multiple_paths: build a DirWatcher that watches multiple directories by passing a list of paths
run_most_recent_change: run most_recent_change on a DirWatcher to get the latest file modification timestamp
test_DirWatcher_caching: test the DirWatcher caching behavior which recalculates only once per second
review_DirWatcher_calculate: review the DirWatcher _calculate method that walks directories and finds the most recent mtime
